# The Machine Anatomy {.unnumbered}

\lettrine{E}{very} physical AI system is defined by the physical apparatus through which it acts. An advisory computation can end at a display or a human decision, although an erroneous output may still cause harm when acted upon. Physical AI operates across a causal threshold where permitted commands drive current, force, and motion. Matter will not pause while an operating system schedules a thread, and a later software rollback cannot undo work already delivered into the plant or environment.

::: {#pri-vol4-irreversibility .callout-principle title="The irreversibility law"}

**Invariant**: Once a permitted command crosses the causal boundary, the energy it delivers becomes motion, strain, or heat that no software action can recall. During a pre-brake delay $\tau_{\text{delay}}$ the machine travels $v\,\tau_{\text{delay}}$ before any response begins, so a stop requires $d_{\text{stop}} \le D_{\text{clear}}$, with every term of $d_{\text{stop}}$ taken from a measured limit of this machine under stated conditions (@sec-body-kinetic-momentum).

**Implication**: Every check that protects the plant must finish before actuation and within the margin that delay has not yet consumed. Each part of the machine therefore carries budgets in time, distance, torque, heat, and voltage, and a design is admissible only when it can say which budget binds first, how that budget was established, and what the machine does when it is exhausted.

:::

* **The Physical Body (@sec-body):** Decides which physical budget binds first and how its value was established, with a process-plant contrast, and produces the limit record from which every later record descends.
* **The Cognitive Brain (@sec-brain):** Decides what a learned proposer can deliver on time and what memory and latency that costs; it produces no record of its own, and its proposer limits enter the handoff record in the limit record's format.
* **The Nervous System (@sec-nervous):** Decides how often the permission path must check and how long a proposal may drive the actuators, and produces the handoff record together with the header that every proposal carries.

Part I hands forward three things. From @sec-body comes a limit record for every budget that can end in damage (stopping distance, delivered torque, winding heat, rail voltage, and measurement age), each with its conditions and its category. From @sec-brain comes the proposer's supply: how many future setpoints one chunk covers, how long a new chunk takes, and how quickly the evidence behind it ages. From @sec-nervous comes the handoff record: the rates and lease the permission path derives from the stopping budget, the handoffs between proposer and permission path, and one worked budget that couples all three chapters on the running machine. Every later record in the book extends it.
